_: GutLog v3.28.0 -- the Plans page. Every assertion fails on v3.27.2 simply because /plans does not exist there, so a version control is available for all eight and proves almost nothing about five of them. Only 01, 02 and 05 are left on it -- they are about a page and a response that genuinely did not exist. The five that guard a PROPERTY (PDF by magic bytes, the login gate, the status whitelist, archive keeping the file, the hashed stored name) are each broken on purpose in the current build instead, because that is the only way to show the assertion responds to the thing it claims to measure. 07 is declared twice: hiding and keeping are two different promises.
